title: myrcia crocea
intro: Myrcia crocea, commonly known as the Golden Myrtle, is a plant species in the family Myrtaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of various health conditions, including respiratory issues, fever, and inflammation, due to its health benefits such as antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Myrcia crocea include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion and coughs, as well as its sedative and anti-spasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, such as myricetin and quercetin, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
